title: Regional GPU SKU transition plan and decommission schedule
body:
Executive summary:
Purpose: provide a pragmatic 18-month transition plan for GPU SKUs across regions that minimizes service disruption, optimizes unit cost, and aligns with contractual constraints. This sheet focuses on SKU transition windows, decommission schedule for legacy cards, active POs, and contingency timelines for lead-time slippage.

Scope & timeline:
- Regions: us-west1, us-east4, eu-west1, apac-sg1 (Singapore).
- Time horizon: Nov 2024 -> Apr 2026 (18 months).
- Focus SKUs: H100-80GB, A100-80GB, L40S-48GB, RTX6000-24GB (legacy), V100-32GB (EOA).

Assumptions:
- Baseline utilization: 72% cluster-wide steady-state; spikes up to 95% for planned launches.
- Customs/port delays: +4 to +12 weeks variability by region.
- Vendor backlog risk: medium through Q1 2025; manufacturers prioritize committed enterprise contracts.
- Trade-in/refresh window requires 2-week maintenance per rack; cross-region transfer takes 3–6 weeks including logistics.

Current inventory snapshot (as-of 2024-11-01):
Region | SKU | Installed | Reserved (DC/Prod) | Available
us-west1 | H100-80GB | 240 | 60 | 180
us-west1 | A100-80GB | 480 | 120 | 360
us-east4 | H100-80GB | 120 | 40 | 80
us-east4 | L40S-48GB | 160 | 40 | 120
eu-west1 | A100-80GB | 200 | 50 | 150
eu-west1 | RTX6000-24GB | 80 | 20 | 60
apac-sg1 | L40S-48GB | 96 | 24 | 72
apac-sg1 | V100-32GB | 40 | 10 | 30
Total installed: 1516 GPUs (by card count).

Active procurement pipeline (orders & key constraints):
- PO-2247 | H100-80GB | qty 120 | vendor: VegaSystems | ETA: 2025-02-10 | status: manufacturing | notes: partial prepayment done; holdback on 12 units for QA.
- PO-2310 | A100-80GB | qty 480 | vendor: HyperLabs | ETA: 2025-05-20 | status: awaiting-shipment | notes: shipment splits: 300 to us-west1, 100 to eu-west1, 80 to apac-sg1.
- PO-2381 | L40S-48GB | qty 192 | vendor: OrionCompute | ETA: 2024-12-18 | status: in-transit | notes: expedited customs for eu-west1.
- Internal reallocation tickets: RALLOC-1023 (move 60 A100 from us-west1 -> us-east4) | ETA complete: 2024-12-05.

Planned transition & decommission milestones (phased):
Phase A (Nov 2024 - Feb 2025): Stabilize incoming L40S and H100 shipments, deprecate V100 in apac-sg1.
- Decommission V100-32GB: schedule small-scale warm drain 2024-12-10 -> 2025-01-05.
- Swap window: 2 racks per weekend in apac-sg1 for hardware swap; downtime mitigation via routing to us-east4.

Phase B (Mar 2025 - Jul 2025): Big refresh; distribute PO-2310 A100s across us-west1/eu-west1; execute cross-region rebalances.
- Cross-region transfer plan: prioritize models with KV-cache portability; avoid moving warm state-heavy clusters except during low-traffic windows.

Phase C (Aug 2025 - Apr 2026): Optimize SKU mix for cost/latency; standardize L40S in inference-heavy pods; finalize legacy RTX6000 decommissions.

Reorder logic and safety buffers (operational rules):
- Target gross safety buffer: 12% of active capacity by region for 95th percentile spike coverage.
- Reorder trigger: projected available capacity < 10% for 4 consecutive weeks -> raise urgent procurement.
- Preferred vendor mix: diversify across 2 primary suppliers per region to reduce single-vendor tail risk.

Scenario matrix (high-level):
- Conservative scenario (lead-time +20%): shift PO-2310 split earlier, retain extra buffer in eu-west1, delay large non-critical releases.
- Optimistic scenario (lead-time -10%): accelerate decommission and reallocate freed racks to staging.
- Contingency (force majeure): invoke fallback routing to dedicated partner clouds for 8–12 weeks; prioritize critical customers on reserved capacity.

Cost and unit economics notes (short):
- H100 units: ~2.6x cost-per-hour vs L40S but 1.8x throughput on large context batched workloads.
- Prefer H100 where batch throughput > latency sensitivity; L40S for low-latency production serving where cost matters.

Risk register (top items):
1) Lead-time slippage on H100 orders -> mitigations: split shipments; secure partial shipments early.
2) Customs/regulatory hold in EU for H100 imports -> mitigation: forward stock to UK staging & pre-clearance.
3) Rack-level power/PDUs mismatch for new cards -> mitigation: pre-check PDU specs, hold 5 test nodes per region.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Approve accelerated PO-2310 split (move 200 units earlier to us-west1) ? (Decision owner: Diego Ramirez, due 2024-11-20)
- Approve trade-in credit program with VegaSystems for V100s (finance/ops input required).

Immediate action items (owner, due):
- Diego Ramirez: confirm PO-2247 partial release schedule with VegaSystems (due 2024-11-18).
- Priya Patel: prepare customs pre-clearance packet for eu-west1 shipments (due 2024-11-22).
- Evan Smith: validate rack PDU draw on new L40S nodes in staging (due 2024-11-30).

Appendix: short checklist for a single rack swap (operational playbook):
1) Pre-validate firmware/drivers in staging.
2) Snapshot KV-cache and drain active sessions (t-48h).
3) Route new traffic to fallback pods.
4) Physical swap (2 technicians, expected 6 hours per rack).
5) Post-swap smoke tests (sloq, p99 lat, throughput).
6) Update inventory & CMDB, close RALLOC ticket.

References & links:
- Procurement master tracker: CONFLUENCE-PLAT-3421
- Rack swap operations doc: CONFLUENCE-OPS-778
- Related PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-procurement/pull/56

Notes to reviewers:
- This is an operational plan (working sheet). Expect weekly updates until Phase B is complete. Comments inline welcome; major changes require sign-off from infra leadership.
